dashboard.name: Pii Team Dashboard
dashboard.purpose: Command center for project management across project origin, activation, operations, risk, gaps, and governance routing.

launch_context.description: The console opens already scoped to one project, analogous to a terminal inheriting a working directory. This is a context-handoff pattern, not an assumption that Centerline currently owns navigation, data model, or authority.

pi_v1_wikillm.role: Reference/governing pattern for PI metadata, source/synthesis/decision separation, field truth states, dashboard state posture, and PAC/LCW/client-overlay boundaries.
pi_v1_wikillm.principle: Use Pi v1 as the WikiLLM/PI pattern while keeping UHG_Dashboard's _governed/ layer as the local project instance.

pac.role: Grace-wide origin/intake framework for project-start sufficiency
pac.principle: PAC is captured once as origin data; later validation and transformation remain visibly downstream.

generic_lcd_w.role: Typical/common Grace project data worksheet overlay for most projects

uhg_lcd_lcw.role: Client-specific, contractually binding UHG framework/workbook variant

excluded_scope.name: Institutional Learning
excluded_scope.reason: DIF-side function, explicitly excluded from Pii Console graph/module scope.

excluded_scope.name: Live Centerline integration
excluded_scope.reason: Pi v1 synthesis keeps Centerline integration deferred unless scope is reopened; current seed may use a Centerline-style handoff pattern only.
